claim: Actual full-source relative differential presentations and compatible degree-six chart ideals are constructed alongside a global proper closed scheme and its ideal datum, with the remaining global sheaf identification explicit.

obligations.name: Full relative kernel from transitivity
obligations.required_input: A Jacobian coefficient cannot be assumed to present the entire relative differential module.
obligations.constructed_input: FramedRelativeDifferentials318 uses the exact Kaehler transitivity sequence for R to R[X] to B and an actual absolute B-linear differential frame.
obligations.justification: projection_kernel proves its full kernel is the span of the image of dX by tensor induction and the polynomial differential basis. relativeGenerator_kernel then identifies it with the principal Jacobian ideal, and quotientEquiv is an actual linear equivalence.

obligations.name: Actual source localization and target scalar map
obligations.required_input: The source localization action on Q[T] must not be confused with the target-coordinate action on the same polynomial ring.
obligations.constructed_input: LocalizedRationalDifferentials318 constructs the source frame by the accepted localization frame theorem, differentiates the actual ratio g/f with a specified inverse, and defines a separate targetAlgebra taking target X to that ratio.
obligations.justification: The entire relative module is presented by the image of g-prime*f minus g*f-prime times the inverse-square. The exact scalar tower is supplied for the target action, with the original source frame fixed independently.

obligations.name: Both actual source cusps and original scheme squares
obligations.required_input: The monic Laurent algebra does not cover either omitted cusp; their own source/target charts are required.
obligations.constructed_input: ThreeJCuspDifferentialCharts318 supplies presentations on D(finiteNumerator) and D(reciprocalNumerator), both mapping to the reciprocal target coordinate1/j.
obligations.justification: finite_scheme_square and infinity_scheme_square identify those coordinate maps with the original global j morphism. Explicit Wronskian factorizations give a square source-coordinate factor at the finite cusp and no such factor at infinity. Their actual rational evaluations are a nonzero finite cofactor1/3^17 and infinity Jacobian1.

obligations.name: Scheme ideals retain multiplicities
obligations.required_input: Equality of zero sets or analytic orders cannot replace an equality of the principal differential ideals.
obligations.constructed_input: finite_jacobian_ideal and infinity_jacobian_ideal identify both full chart Jacobian ideals with extensions of the explicit degree-six finite equation and its reciprocal-chart equation.
obligations.justification: The actual localization inverse is proved a unit and only its square and sign are removed. No radical or reduced-point quotient is substituted.

obligations.name: Full original overlap and degree-six transition
obligations.required_input: Descent must hold on the actual entire scheme overlap with the correct scalar factor.
obligations.constructed_input: The homogeneous equation has degree six. overlap_equation proves finiteEquation(T)=T^6*infinityEquation(S) in the original Laurent intersection with T*S=1.
obligations.justification: overlap_ideal identifies the images of the two polynomial principal ideals under the original finite and reciprocal inclusion ring maps. The factor T^6 is removed only because T is explicitly a unit on that whole intersection.

obligations.name: Literal Laurent differential join
obligations.required_input: The transported monic annihilator from the predecessor must actually present the literal Laurent Kaehler module with the j action.
obligations.constructed_input: ThreeJLaurentDifferentialJoin318 constructs that presentation with the rational-coordinate frame method, proves actual_algebra equals the original jAlgebra, and compares the framed coefficient with the monic derivative image times S^3.
obligations.justification: literal_coefficient_ideal removes that explicit unit and literalLaurentPresentation identifies the literal original relative differential module with the quotient by originalDifferentialIdeal. The prior transported-ideal boundary is thereby closed on the Laurent chart.

obligations.name: Actual global closed scheme and complete source coverage
obligations.required_input: A proposed global ramification object must exist as a scheme with no spurious infinity support, and every differential chart must be accounted for.
obligations.constructed_input: ThreeJGlobalRamificationScheme318 constructs Spec of the monic degree-six ramification equation, proves its Q-rank is six, and embeds it into the original projective source as a proper closed immersion. Its kernel is a global IdealSheafData object.
obligations.justification: finite_kernel retains the full defining ideal and support_in_finite_chart excludes an extra infinity component. every_source_point proves all-prime coverage by the Laurent and the two cusp differential charts, using original chart coverage and coprimality rather than complex-point exhaustion.

obligations.name: Exact hosted repair and immutable evidence
obligations.required_input: Repair only the reported category projection failures and preserve the actual tested evidence.
obligations.constructed_input: The two symmetric rational-pair evaluation modules explicitly simplify AlgHom-to-RingHom evaluation and fully expose the typed aeval compositions before rewriting heval.
obligations.justification: The denominator failures at lines22 and54 on commit c7d3bc3 are recorded with the exact available RESULT/log; the numerator receives the same source-supported projection fix. All other89 predecessors are byte-identical; no statement, map or mathematical hypothesis changes.

obligations.name: Genus, validation and remaining global comparison
obligations.required_input: The genus-zero modular parameter map must remain distinct from genus-four contact curves, and local presentations must not be mislabeled as an already proved global Fitting-sheaf equality.
obligations.constructed_input: The actual map is degree4 P1 to P1. The source divisor has weights2,2,1,1 and degree6, and its pushforward has weights2,2,2. Six new sources plus two narrow repairs form97.
obligations.justification: The global closed scheme and compatible chart ideals are now constructed, and literal relative modules are presented on a full source cover. Equality of the global kernel ideal with a globally defined relative-differential/Fitting sheaf, and formal restriction identification of that global ideal on every chart, remain separate. No local Lean, no integral characteristic3 extension, no PEL or full318/326 claim.
